A Driver can apply to register to compete in the Championship as either a Championship Registered Driver or a Casually Registered Driver .

A Driver will only be considered as being registered to compete in the Championship as a Championship Registered Driver following:

Lodgment of a completed Registration Application Form and associated Commercial Agreement;

Receipt of written confirmation from PCA that their application has been unconditionally accepted;

Payment of the applicable Registration Fee as detailed in the Commercial Agreement; and

Receipt of written notification from the CM that they are registered.

The CM reserves the right to accept or refuse a Registration Application Form from any Driver in its sole and absolute discretion without providing any reasons.
